contentPattern: Optional first row: filter title (e.g. "Care Area"). Then one row per item: [thumbnail image] [rich text: linked title, description] [tags, comma separated]. Tags build the checkbox filter sidebar.
usage: Tutorial and clinical image libraries in the education section.
reuseGuidance: Use featured-grid-pagination for the clinical images library: first result spans the grid and results are paginated (9 per page).
